title: The documented example
demonstrates: A strong, well-specified role. Imperfect paper fit (React, TypeScript) against high compensation and career capital - the pattern the whole tool is built to surface.
expect: STRONGLY PURSUE, with the gaps classified as high-proofability rather than disqualifying.
raw_text:

title: Great pay, hard gate
demonstrates: The highest-paying role in the set is the one to walk away from. A CI polygraph does not satisfy a Full Scope requirement, and no amount of skill demonstrates around it.
expect: Compensation scores near 100, the overall score is capped, and the draft is a polite decline.

title: The content-free ping
demonstrates: A message that says nothing. Rather than guessing, the system reports what is absent in priority order and drafts the questions that would make it evaluable.
expect: Almost nothing extracted, a long missing-information list, and a draft asking for the blocking items.

title: Low base, high equity
demonstrates: Why compensation and upside are separate dimensions. Averaging them would hide both the pay cut and the ownership.
expect: A modest compensation score alongside a strong upside score, and elevated risk.
raw_text:
Subject: Founding Engineer at Halcyon Bio

Hi Eric,

We're a seed-stage company applying machine learning to drug discovery. We just closed our seed round. Team of 9 people.

We're looking for a founding engineer to own our entire platform end-to-end - greenfield, high ambiguity, zero to one. You'd work across Python, PyTorch, computational biology pipelines and cloud infrastructure, and you'd be talking to our pharma customers directly.

Base is $150,000 with 0.8% - 1.2% equity. Fully remote. Expect roughly 50 hours per week; we're honest about that. No clearance required.

Best,
Sofia Almeida
sofia@halcyonbio.example

title: Comfortable and stagnant
demonstrates: Good paper fit is not a reason to pursue. The candidate qualifies easily; the role builds little that compounds.
expect: Respectable fit, weak career capital and upside, and a low overall score.

Job Title: Intelligence Analyst III
Company: Beacon Ridge Consulting
Location: Chantilly, VA

Responsibilities: Provide all-source intelligence analysis and reporting support to a government customer. This is a level of effort contract supporting an existing program. Maintain existing analytic products and respond to customer RFIs via the ticket queue. Shift work may be required on the watch floor.

Requirements: Active TS/SCI with CI polygraph. Bachelor's degree in a relevant field. 5+ years of all-source intelligence experience.

Salary: $105,000 - $125,000. No equity.
Travel: no travel.
Schedule: 40 hours per week.

title: Revenue-carrying technical role
demonstrates: Base, OTE and equity parsed as three different numbers, and commission treated as genuine upside rather than as base pay.
expect: The strongest overall score in the set.
raw_text:
Hi Eric,

We're hiring a Forward Deployed AI Engineer at Cassini Labs (Series B, ~140 employees). You'd be embedded with enterprise customers deploying our agentic AI platform - building RAG pipelines, evaluation harnesses and custom integrations in Python and TypeScript, then owning the outcome with the customer.

Base $200,000-$235,000, OTE $280,000 with commission, plus equity (0.05%-0.1%). Hybrid in New York, NY - 3 days per week in office. Expect up to 30% travel to customer sites. No clearance required.

Interested?

Marcus Oyelaran
marcus@cassinilabs.example

title: Polygraph, scope unstated
demonstrates: The ambiguity that costs the most time. 'A polygraph' could mean a few weeks or over a year, so the system asks which before anything else.
expect: A clearance-clarification draft that names CI and Full Scope explicitly.
